Estate Jewelry Buyer Leads in Atlanta

How It Works

  • First 3 leads free – Try the service at no cost.
  • $40 per accepted lead – You pay only for leads you accept.
  • Optional Pro website widget – $12/month.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Local – Starting in Atlanta, with other metros planned.
  • Clear pricing – A flat $40 per accepted lead after the free leads.

FAQ

Does CaratBase provide leads for estate jewelry buyers in Atlanta? CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and sends leads to estate buyers, appraisers, and independent jewelers.
